Related work: conditional and class-conditional conformal prediction, many/long-tailed classes, group-conditional QR calibration, Kandinsky, selection-conditional and trust-score variants (descriptions limited to titles and venues).
Related work: efficiency, classifier adaptation, temperature scaling, foundation-model features, Monte Carlo and interpretable-network conformal methods (titles/venues only).

Related work: conformal methods for time series, ordinal labels, heteroskedastic regression, multivariate residuals, epistemic uncertainty, scenario optimisation, and applied treatments (clinical imaging, histopathology) (titles/venues only).

Split conformal prediction with a held-out calibration set and Mondrian (partition-cell) conformal prediction are established foundations with finite-sample marginal/cell-conditional validity under exchangeability (background statement; the paper claims no new guarantee).

Baseline score families: LAC thresholds softmax mass (Sadinle et al.), APS accumulates randomised sorted mass (Romano et al.), RAPS adds a rank penalty (Angelopoulos et al.); the evaluator implementations, not the cited papers, define the exact baselines scored.

Weighted conformal prediction under covariate shift restores marginal coverage when the density ratio is known; estimated ratios give only approximate guarantees (background for the gated weighting step).
Aitchison log-ratio compositional data analysis motivates the simplex framing; the studied procedure does not use log-ratio coordinates.
